job.title: Hands-on Engineering Manager (C#/Vue)
job.description:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA + South America)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: €82,000–140,000; determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into.

This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them.

About Miaplaza

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on

We’re a C# and Vue.js platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers.

How management works at Miaplaza

We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before:

  1. You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable.

  2. You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first.

  3. You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output.

  4. Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too.

What you must bring

We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages

  • 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework

  • 3+ years of experience with software architecture

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader

  • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

What makes you stand out

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

  • Experience with consumer platforms at scale

  • Experience building in regulated environments

  • Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.)

  • Extensive senior front-end development experience

Responsibilities

  • Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js

  • Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families

  • Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time.

  1. Application and CV review. We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update.

  2. Initial technical screen (20 min). A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role.

  3. Behavioral interview (1 hour). With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far.

  4. 1st technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work.

  5. 2nd technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it.

  6. Leadership interview (1 hour). With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership.

  7. Reference check. We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report.

  8. Offer and background check. Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area.

Miaplaza is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

job.title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer / Solution Architect (Snowflake)
job.description:
Hello,

Job Title : Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer / Solution Architect (Snowflake)

Client:  Arrow Electronics

Location: Remote

Duration: 7 months

Rate: $75/hr on C2C

What Candidate Will Be Doing

Lead product and solution architecture, clarify requirements with stakeholders, and turn them into a practical delivery plan.

Design and implement the application across its user experience, APIs, persistence layer, integrations, deployment, and operational documentation.

Make sound tradeoffs for security, usability, data integrity, maintainability, and future reporting.

Partner with PMO, product, data, security, and operations stakeholders through launch and ongoing support.

What You Will Build

Workflow and UI Design: Turn the PMO process into a simple update flow with an editable milestone grid, product and revision groups, field validation, date variance, and “Path to Green” prompts. Build accessible, keyboard-friendly data-entry experiences.

Application and Database Design: Build secure APIs and a transactional data model for programs, product revisions, milestones, owners, statuses, and dates. Support concurrent edits safely and shape data for future reporting.

Field-Level Audit History: Capture who changed each field, when, and its previous and new values. Include a change reason where appropriate, and retain audit events separately from current values.

Snowflake Integration: Design reliable data movement, authentication, error handling, retries, reconciliation, and monitoring. Clearly explain how application data enters Snowflake and stays in sync. Snowflake Streams and Tasks can support CDC patterns after changed data is in Snowflake; define the upstream movement and synchronization design as part of the solution.

Enterprise Security and Operations: Implement SSO, role-based access, protected credentials, deployment pipelines, backups, logging, and support documentation. Apply least-privilege access and appropriate authentication for application connections.

What We Are Looking For

Senior experience delivering and operating full-stack business applications in production, with ownership across architecture and implementation.

Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer / Solution Architect (Snowflake)

Demonstrated ability to design secure APIs, transactional data models, and reliable systems that handle concurrent updates and preserve data integrity.

Hands-on production Snowflake integration experience, including application-to-warehouse data movement, authentication, failure recovery, reconciliation, and monitoring.

Practical experience with enterprise identity, authorization, secrets management, CI/CD, backups, observability, and production support.

Strong communication: can explain architecture choices, risks, and operational behavior to technical and nontechnical partners.

Experience building accessible, keyboard-friendly, high-efficiency data-entry interfaces.

Experience with field-level audit/event history, data lineage, and reporting-oriented data design.

Experience with Snowflake Streams and Tasks, and a clear understanding of where those mechanisms fit in a complete end-to-end integration.

What to Include in Your Resume

Describe a production application you owned end to end, including your role and architecture. Explain a Snowflake integration you delivered: how data moved into Snowflake, how synchronization and retries worked, and how failures were detected and reconciled. Include your approach to field-level audit history, concurrent edits, security, deployment, and support.

job.title: Lead, Finance & Analytics
job.description:
About Atomic

Atomic Industries is reinventing how the world makes things. From cars and aerospace systems to medical devices and packaging, most physical goods begin life in a mold or are shaped by a manufacturing tool. Producing these tools has always been slow, manual, and dependent on scarce expertise, taking weeks or months. We're changing that.

At our Detroit headquarters, we combine the industrial DNA of America's manufacturing heartland with the speed, intelligence, and precision of Silicon Valley. Our AI-driven platform tackles the hardest problems in geometry, process planning, and fabrication, collapsing production timelines from months to days and soon, minutes. We don't just build software; we run a fully operational factory where our technology produces production-grade tooling every week, enabling tight feedback loops and rapid iteration.

Backed by top-tier investors, we're restoring speed, flexibility, and capability to the American industrial base. Our mission is to make manufacturing as agile and scalable as the digital world, and in doing so, rebuild the infrastructure of the physical economy.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Lead, Finance & Analytics to build the data foundation of Atomic's finance operating system. You'll connect the company's financial and operational data, from our accounting, spend, and planning systems to the production data captured on the factory floor, into one clean, trusted source of truth. On top of it, you'll build the reporting, AI tools, and automations that let a small finance team see the business clearly and move fast. The bar: every analysis, whether done by a person or an AI agent, starts from the same numbers. You'll partner with Finance, Accounting, Operations, and Engineering, and help bring finance into Nucleus, Atomic's internal platform.

This is the founding data role on the finance team, reporting to the Head of Finance. It's built for someone who wants to define what a modern, AI-native finance function looks like inside a manufacturing tech company.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and own Atomic's finance data infrastructure: connect our accounting, spend, and planning systems into one trusted source of truth that every report, model, and agent starts from.
  • Connect operational data to finance, turning production and equipment data such as machine time, cycle times, materials, and scrap into clear insight on cost, margin, and capacity.
  • Make accuracy non-negotiable. Logic is tested and ties to the general ledger, with reconciliation checks and controls, so Accounting and leadership trust every number.
  • Work with Finance and Accounting to define the common structure (entities, departments, accounts, jobs, cost allocation) once, so every report and tool inherits the same definitions.
  • Bring plan and actuals together, so leaders can drill from any budget variance down to the transactions behind it.
  • Build the interfaces: Excel-ready outputs for the close, real-time reporting for leadership, and AI agents and automations that work from the same source of truth.
  • Lead systems projects end to end and act as the bridge between Finance and Engineering on Nucleus and internal tools.
  • Own the finance systems roadmap: evaluate and pilot AI and vendor tools, train the team, and extend the platform as Atomic adds factories and complexity.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or finance systems, including at least one financial data or reporting platform you built and ran in production.
  • Strong Python and SQL, and data modeling experience (facts, dimensions, hierarchies). We care about outcomes, not a specific toolset.
  • Working fluency in accounting and finance. You can discuss the chart of accounts, the close, and reconciliations with a Controller and turn them into a data model.
  • An auditor's instinct for accuracy: you tie out to the books, test your logic, and treat a number that doesn't reconcile as a bug.
  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI tools such as agents and workflow automation. This means real build experience, not just interest.
  • Founding-hire ownership: you scope the first version yourself, ship it, drive adoption, and grow the function from there.
  • Clear, plain-English communication with finance and operations leaders, and comfort working directly with engineers.
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field, accounting, finance, or computer science, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a high-growth hard-tech, manufacturing, or fintech company.
  • Experience with manufacturing or production data, such as ERP and MES systems, bills of materials, work orders, or machine and sensor data.
  • Accounting or FP&A experience.
  • Experience setting up data systems from scratch at an early-stage company.
  • Familiarity with controls over financial systems (SOX / IT general controls).

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and generous equity package
  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents
  • 401(k)
  • PTO

job.title: Dynatrace Senior Consultant – Site Reliability Engineering
job.description:
Company Overview:

Arctiq is a leader in professional IT services and managed services across three core Centers of Excellence: Enterprise Security, Modern Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering. Renowned for our ability to architect intelligence, we connect, protect, and transform organizations, empowering them to thrive in today's digital landscape. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

Position Overview:

We are looking for a Dynatrace Senior Consultant with a Site Reliability Engineering focus to deliver observability engagements for Arctiq customers. Working under the direction of our Delivery Architects, you will turn Dynatrace into the foundation for reliability practices, implementing SLIs and SLOs, alerting, and incident workflows that customer teams can run on their own. You have lived site reliability engineering practice in production and can show customers how to apply it.

Responsibilities:

  • Deliver Dynatrace implementations for SaaS and Managed environments, following designs set by the Delivery Architect.
  • Implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets in Dynatrace, working with customer teams to define meaningful reliability targets.
  • Configure alerting, anomaly detection, and problem notification to reduce noise and shorten time to detection.
  • Build Dynatrace Workflows and automated remediation using ecosystem tools such as Ansible.
  • Support incident response by building runbooks, dashboards, and on-call integrations (such as PagerDuty and Opsgenie).
  • Implement Dynatrace integrations with ServiceNow and the Atlassian suite to support incident and problem management.
  • Help customers run blameless post-incident reviews and use Dynatrace data to drive reliability improvements.
  • Implement configuration as code for Dynatrace using Terraform and the Dynatrace Configuration APIs and tooling.
  • Configure core observability capabilities such as tagging, synthetics, RUM, logging, and dashboards.
  • Support Gen2 to Gen3 migration workstreams, including alerting, dashboards, and automation.
  • Document solutions and run knowledge-transfer sessions so customer teams can operate independently.
  • Keep delivery work on scope, schedule, and budget, and flag risks early to the Delivery Architect and engagement lead.
  • Travel up to 25% for project kick-offs, workshops, and close-outs.
  • Pursue continued education through training and industry certifications.

Qualifications:

    • 5+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, operations, or platform engineering, including 2+ years delivering on the Dynatrace platform.
    • Demonstrated site reliability engineering discipline, with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets that you have operationalized in production environments.
    • Experience designing alerting strategies and incident response processes.
    • Working knowledge of Dynatrace Managed and SaaS deployments.
    • Working knowledge of Dynatrace Workflows and automated remediation.
    • Familiarity with core observability practices: tagging, synthetics, RUM, logging, and dashboards.
    • Active Dynatrace Associate certification, or willingness to obtain it within the first 90 days.
    • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work directly with customer practitioners and operations leaders.
    • Ability to travel up to 25%.

    Technical Requirements:

    • Experience with AWS or Azure.
    • Hands-on experience with Terraform.
    • Experience with Kubernetes.
    • Working knowledge of network-related signals for observability.
    • Exposure to OpenTelemetry (OTel) and observability pipelines.

    Nice to have:

    • Experience with Ansible or other automation tools.
    • Hands-on integration experience with ServiceNow and the Atlassian suite.
    • Exposure to Gen2 to Gen3 Dynatrace migration.
    • Active higher-level Dynatrace certification, such as Dynatrace Implementation or Dynatrace Professional.
    • Experience with competing platforms such as Splunk, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, and AppDynamics.
    • Prior consulting or professional services experience.

Our culture is collaborative, high-growth, and agile. You’ll join an experienced and motivated executive team with backgrounds from Instructure (Canvas) and other successful edtech companies with exit experience. We operate as a distributed team across the UK and US, with offices in London.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own hard problems across our platform end to end: from an ambiguous problem to a shipped, reliable outcome, without waiting to be handed tickets. You'll work directly with product, customers and the wider business, and shape what gets built as well as how.

How we build software is changing fast. AI-assisted development is our default way of working, and we expect it to keep changing under us. We want someone who finds that energising rather than tolerating it: who uses AI agents to move dramatically faster, stays rigorous about what ships, and helps define how the rest of the team works.

The work isn't simple CRUD. Some of our hardest problems:

  • Content at scale: ingesting, normalising and delivering content from 4,000+ publishers with inconsistent formats, metadata and licensing rules.
  • Day 1 load: hundreds of thousands of students hitting the platform in the same few days at the start of term. It has to work first time.
  • Institutional integrations: LMSs (Canvas, D2L, Blackboard, Moodle), student information systems, SSO and campus store systems, as well as Point of Sale (POS) each configured differently at each institution.
  • Money and compliance: inclusive access billing, opt-outs and charges to student accounts must be correct, auditable and PCI/GDPR-safe.
  • Evolving a growing estate: modernising older services and integrating acquired systems without stopping the business.
  • AI in the product: building learning features on top of licensed content, where accuracy, cost and rights all matter.

What you will be doing

  • Own complex features and services end to end: scoping, design, delivery, operation and iteration
  • Use AI coding agents as a core part of how you work, and build the specs, tests, evals and guardrails that make their output trustworthy
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into clear technical plans, and push back when the problem is wrong
  • Design for reliability under seasonal load: observability, graceful degradation, and knowing what breaks first
  • Modernise legacy areas safely (characterisation tests, incremental migration, strangler patterns) rather than big-bang rewrites
  • Take part in incident response and post-incident reviews, and fix causes rather than symptoms
  • Review code with a risk-based eye: deep on core systems, fast at the edges
  • Raise the bar for those around you: mentor engineers, and help non-engineers building internal tools with AI do it safely
  • Partner with security on threat modelling and secure-by-design patterns

What we are looking for

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to pick up new languages and tools quickly

job.title: Blockchain Reference Data Analyst
job.description:
Why This Role?

At Lukka, accurate and comprehensive data is fundamental to making the digital asset ecosystem more transparent, reliable and accountable. As a Blockchain Reference Data Analyst, you will help build and maintain the structured reference data that enables Lukka's products to identify, classify, connect and interpret blockchain networks, digital assets, tokens, protocols and entities.

You will combine blockchain research, data analysis, Data Science and automation to transform information from disparate sources into reliable, standardized and continuously maintained reference datasets. You will investigate complex data discrepancies, develop analytical methods to improve data quality, identify patterns and anomalies, and build intelligent workflows that make reference data management more scalable.

This is not a traditional data-entry or data-processing role. We are looking for an analytical thinker who can combine research expertise with Python, SQL, statistical methods and AI-assisted tools to improve the accuracy, completeness and usability of blockchain reference data.

You will work closely with Blockchain Engineers, Blockchain Data Analysts & Researchers, Product and Operations teams to establish trusted data foundations for Lukka's digital asset products.

What You'll Do

  • Build Blockchain Reference Data: Research, identify, classify and maintain structured information about blockchain networks, digital assets, tokens, smart contracts, protocols, wallets, exchanges and related entities.
  • Develop Data Models and Taxonomies: Create and maintain standardized schemas, classifications, attributes and relationships that enable consistent interpretation of reference data across blockchain ecosystems.
  • Apply Data Science to Data Quality: Use statistical analysis, anomaly detection, clustering, similarity matching and other analytical techniques to identify inconsistencies, duplicates, missing attributes and potentially incorrect classifications.
  • Automate Research and Validation: Develop Python-based workflows that collect, normalize, validate and enrich reference data from public APIs, blockchain explorers, project documentation, registries and other credible sources.
  • Build Intelligent Entity Resolution: Apply rule-based and machine-learning approaches to match entities, detect duplicates, resolve naming variations and establish relationships between assets, networks, protocols and organizations.
  • Establish Data Quality Frameworks: Define measurable quality dimensions, validation rules, confidence scores and exception thresholds for reference data accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness and freshness.
  • Investigate Complex Data Discrepancies: Research conflicting or incomplete information across multiple sources, assess source reliability and document evidence supporting data decisions.
  • Leverage AI and LLMs: Use AI-assisted research, information extraction and classification to accelerate data enrichment, while applying appropriate validation and human review to maintain reliability.
  • Build Monitoring and Analytical Dashboards: Track coverage, data-quality trends, unresolved exceptions, source freshness and enrichment performance to identify gaps and prioritize improvements. Maintain accuracy of Lukka’s data products. Assess various sources of crypto reference data and determine data quality. Monitor daily processes to ensure complete and accurate data throughout our entire ecosystem. Define new process improvement opportunities
  • Collaborate with Engineering: Translate data requirements and analytical findings into implementable specifications, validation rules, automated workflows and API or pipeline requirements.
  • Support Product and Customer Needs: Investigate reference-data issues, assess their downstream impact and contribute to enhancements that improve the usability and reliability of Lukka's products. Proactively work with clients to understand their problems and develop solutions to ensure their data needs are met. Integrate customer feedback into the Lukka Product development lifecycle. Leverage business knowledge of the crypto asset ecosystem to support clients who are new to the space. Troubleshoot customer issues.
  • Continuously Improve Processes: Identify repetitive manual work, recommend automation opportunities and develop reproducible research methods, documentation and standard operating procedures. Define requirements with technology teams to enhance the platform and data delivery mechanisms. Research new crypto trends and events for product expansion.

What You'll Need

Experience

  • 2–5 years of experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Reference Data, Financial Data or a related analytical role.
  • Strong experience working with structured and semi-structured datasets, data validation and analytical problem-solving.
  • Experience developing data-driven solutions using Python and SQL.
  • Blockchain or digital asset experience is preferred; a strong interest in blockchain technology and the ability to learn new protocols are essential.

Data Science & Programming

  • Proficiency in Python for data analysis, transformation, validation and automation.
  • Hands-on experience with Pandas or Polars and libraries such as NumPy and SciPy.
  • Working knowledge of statistical methods, exploratory data analysis, outlier detection and data-quality measurement.
  • Familiarity with machine-learning techniques for classification, clustering, entity resolution or similarity matching.
  • Experience with scikit-learn is an advantage.
  • Ability to write SQL queries for data profiling, reconciliation, analysis and quality monitoring.

Data Engineering & Integration

  • Experience consuming REST APIs and working with JSON and other semi-structured data formats.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data normalization, schema design and data validation.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and cloud data platforms such as AWS S3 and RDS.
  • Experience with automated data pipelines, scheduled workflows or orchestration tools is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with dashboards and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar platforms is a plus.

Blockchain & Reference Data

  • Understanding of blockchain fundamentals, including networks, addresses, transactions, tokens, smart contracts and consensus mechanisms.
  • Ability to research and validate digital asset information using blockchain explorers, project documentation, public APIs and other authoritative sources.
  • Familiarity with EVM-compatible networks, Bitcoin, Solana or other blockchain ecosystems is an advantage.
  • Understanding of entity master data, asset classification, identifiers, taxonomies and relationship mapping is desirable.
  • Knowledge of financial markets, securities reference data, market data or digital asset classification is a plus.

Data Quality & Analytical Thinking

  • Strong investigative skills and attention to detail, combined with the ability to explain findings quantitatively.
  • Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from conflicting, incomplete or low-confidence information.
  • A structured approach to defining validation rules, measuring quality and investigating root causes.
  • Ability to turn analytical findings into actionable recommendations and repeatable processes.

AI-Native Mindset

  • Willingness to use AI tools for research, data extraction, classification, coding and documentation.
  • Ability to validate AI-generated outputs independently and identify hallucinations, unsupported claims and incorrect classifications.
  • Interest in combining AI with deterministic rules, statistical methods and human review to improve data quality and productivity.

Collaboration & Ownership

  • Ability to work with Engineering, Product, Research and Operations teams across geographies.
  • Clear documentation and communication skills.
  • A proactive approach to identifying problems, proposing improvements and taking ownership through resolution.

What Success Looks Like

  • Reference datasets achieve agreed targets for accuracy, completeness, consistency and freshness.
  • Coverage of blockchain networks, digital assets and related entities expands in line with product requirements.
  • Manual research and repetitive validation are reduced through automation and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Data discrepancies are detected earlier, investigated systematically and resolved with documented evidence.
  • Entity matching, classification and enrichment become more consistent, measurable and scalable.
  • Product and Engineering teams receive reliable, well-documented reference data and actionable analytical insights.

Why Join Lukka?

Lukka solves complex data and technology challenges in an industry that continues to evolve rapidly. Since 2014, we have anticipated the needs of the digital asset ecosystem and developed products that help make crypto more accountable.

As part of the team, you will help establish the trusted data foundations on which digital asset products depend. You will have the opportunity to combine Data Science, blockchain research and automation to solve real-world problems, influence data standards and create measurable value for customers.

Of Course, Let's Discuss Some Perks

  • Work directly with digital asset data supporting products used by established clients.
  • Apply Data Science and AI to complex, real-world data challenges.
  • Gain exposure to multiple blockchain ecosystems and evolving data standards.
  • Collaborate with global teams and influence the development of data products.
  • Work in a startup-style environment where your contribution and impact are visible.

Development Associate

Together for Girls works around the world and combines state-of-the-art data with powerful advocacy to end violence against children and adolescents, especially sexual violence. As the host of the Brave Movement, a survivor-led global advocacy initiative, we support and mobilize survivors and allies worldwide to drive political will, influence policy, and ensure that inaction is not an option.

By connecting the dots between understanding the problem, identifying effective solutions, tracking progress, and getting solutions into the hands of those with the power to make change, TfG amplifies our impact and drives toward the ultimate goal of creating a safer world for children and adolescents.

We are rooted in the conviction that violence is preventable and chance is possible, drawing upon 19 years of data from the Violence Against Children and Youth Surveys (VACS), new and emerging science, and lived experience. The Safe Futures Solutions Hub shares evidence and practice-based knowledge to inform effective prevention and response efforts, ensuring access to proven solutions across sectors. The Out of the Shadows Index tracks countries’ progress in addressing violence, providing an accountability framework and benchmark for advocacy. Brave Movement members and other activists leverage these tools to transform evidence into collective action for prevention, healing, and justice.

We are a nimble and highly impactful team that continues to grow and evolve. We work with a broad range of organizations, researchers, and advocates to drive change.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Development Associate to provide essential operational and coordination support across the Development team.

The Associate will help ensure that the Development function operates efficiently by maintaining the CRM and fundraising records, conducting prospect and opportunity research, tracking funding opportunities and deadlines, supporting proposal development, and coordinating fundraising materials and events.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong attention to detail, excellent organisation and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. The Associate will work closely with colleagues in the Development team, as well as across Communications, Programmes and Finance.

  • Prepare meeting materials, presentations, briefing documents and other information as required.
  • Coordinate logistics, invitations, follow-up and administrative arrangements for Development events and engagement opportunities.
  • Support donor acknowledgements and other routine stewardship activity.

  • Help ensure Development processes and information are well organized, accessible and consistently maintained.
  • Identify opportunities to improve systems and processes and support the team in implementing them.

Other duties, as assigned.

Essential

job.description:
📍 Remote (U.S.-Based) | Optional hybrid in the Bay Area
Reports to: Senior Director, Asynchronous Care
Job Type: Full-time W2

Overview 

Midi Health is on a mission to redesign care for women in midlife — and we're growing fast. As our asynchronous operations scale, we need better visibility into how work moves through our inboxes, how our teams perform, and how to deploy our workforce efficiently. 

We're looking for a Senior Operations Manager, Analytics & Workforce Planning to build and own the analytical and workforce planning capabilities that power our Async Operations organization. 

This person will design and establish the metrics, reporting frameworks, and workforce models that help us understand demand, throughput, productivity, service levels, and cost. You'll turn complex operational data into actionable insights that help leaders make better decisions every day. 

You'll work closely with Async Operations leaders to identify what's driving SLA performance, where work is getting stuck, how much capacity we need, and where we can improve productivity or eliminate unnecessary work. You'll independently identify opportunities, develop recommendations, and influence decisions about staffing, workflows, and technology investments. 

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, operationally minded, and comfortable independently exploring complex datasets. They're excited to use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, build models, and solve operational problems. They can translate data into clear recommendations that help leaders make better staffing, workflow, and operational decisions. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building analytical capabilities from the ground up and using data to drive operational change. 

The goal: Deliver an excellent patient experience while continuously improving throughput, workforce efficiency, and cost per visit. 

You won't just report on how the inbox is performing - you'll help us figure out how to make it perform better.

What you'll do 

Operational Analytics & Performance 

  • Design and own the analytics and reporting framework for Async Operations, providing visibility into volume, throughput, turnaround times, backlogs, productivity, and SLAs.
  • Build dashboards, reporting, and recurring analyses that help leaders understand operational performance and take action. 
  • Establish consistent definitions and measurement frameworks for key inbox metrics across teams and workflows. 
  • Analyze how work moves through the inbox, including incoming volume, completed work, aging, handoffs, and bottlenecks. 
  • Independently lead complex analyses to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities, including in areas where existing data or measurement frameworks are incomplete. 
  • Partner with Operations leaders to translate insights into measurable process and performance improvements. 

SLA & Throughput Management 

  • Develop and own the analytical approach to understanding, monitoring, and improving SLA performance across inbox workflows. 
  • Identify whether SLA misses are driven by demand, staffing, productivity, routing, workflow design, or technology. 
  • Analyze throughput and backlog trends to identify where work is accumulating and what interventions will have the greatest impact. 
  • Develop leading indicators that help teams proactively identify service-level risks before they become problems. 
  • Measure the impact of operational changes on response times, throughput, quality, and patient experience. 
  • Recommend and help prioritize operational interventions based on expected impact, feasibility, and resource requirements. 

Workforce Planning & Capacity Management 

  • Design and establish workforce forecasting and capacity planning models that translate expected work volumes into staffing requirements by team, workflow, skill, and time period. 
  • Own the development of annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly workforce plans, with visibility into daily capacity needs. 
  • Account for productivity, scheduling, PTO, training, shrinkage, and other factors that affect available capacity. 
  • Analyze workforce utilization and productivity to identify opportunities to improve resource allocation.
  • Advise Operations leadership on staffing requirements, workforce allocation, cross-training, and capacity shifts to protect SLAs while optimizing cost. 
  • Lead capacity scenario planning for seasonal demand, holiday coverage, growth, and changes in operational workflows. 

Productivity & Cost Optimization 

  • Develop and own the measurement frameworks for productivity, cost per completed action, and async cost per visit.

job.title: Revenue Operations Analytics Manager
job.description:
The Company

Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond.  We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments. 

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it. 

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The Revenue Operations Analytics Manager is a strategic and highly visible role responsible for driving operational excellence, scalable processes, and data-driven decision-making across the revenue organization. This individual serves as a trusted partner to Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Executive Leadership, translating complex data into actionable insights that directly influence business strategy and performance.

This role owns critical components of revenue operations, including sales compensation execution, performance analytics, and executive reporting. In addition to delivering accurate and timely insights, the Senior Analyst proactively identifies opportunities to optimize processes, improve data integrity, and enhance forecasting accuracy.

As a key contributor to strategic planning and revenue optimization, this individual plays a central role in enabling predictable, scalable growth while continuously evolving reporting frameworks, compensation programs, and operational processes.

What You Do

Sales Compensation Ownership & Strategy

  • Own the build and end-to-end administration of sales compensation programs, including plan implementation, maintenance, and commission calculations.
  • Test new plans and changes before release. Document expected results, check edge cases, and validate Salesforce inputs and commission calculations against approved plan terms.
  • Lead monthly and quarterly compensation cycles, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely delivery.
  • Partner with Finance, People, and RevOps leadership to ensure alignment with payroll, audit, and compliance requirements.
  • Analyze compensation effectiveness and lead modeling efforts to optimize plan design and align incentives with business objectives.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to increase scalability, accuracy, and efficiency of compensation operations.

Revenue Operations & Executive Reporting

  • Own and evolve executive and board-level reporting, including pipeline health, bookings, forecast accuracy, and key performance metrics.
  • Design and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide clear visibility into business performance.
  • Deliver actionable insights on sales performance, productivity, and forecasting trends, influencing strategic decision-making.
  • Lead complex data analysis initiatives, synthesizing insights across multiple systems (e.g., Salesforce, BI tools).
  • Partner with senior leadership to support planning cycles, QBRs, and strategic initiatives.

AI Agents and Workflow Automation

  • Identify and prioritize RevOps workflows for agentic AI based on business impact, manual effort, data readiness, and risk. Define the expected outcome and how to measure it before building.
  • Build and maintain multi-step workflows with Claude or comparable tools. Define which data sources each workflow uses, what it checks, and when it routes an exception to a person.
  • Strengthen Board and executive reporting. Build workflows to reconcile metrics across Salesforce, Power BI, and Finance, flag unexplained variances, and draft commentary tied to verified figures for human review.
  • Support GTM planning and analysis. Use agentic workflows to compare quota, capacity, and territory scenarios, document assumptions, and show which inputs drive the largest changes in projected bookings.
  • Validate workflows before release and after changes. Test against known outcomes and edge cases, track false positives and missed exceptions, and require human approval before workflows update records or distribute sensitive reports.
  • Measure results and support adoption. Track time saved, exception accuracy, and usage. Document workflows and train analysts and business partners to run them, review outputs, and troubleshoot common issues.

GTM Systems Administration

  • Own day-to-day administration of Gong and assigned sales intelligence tools. Manage user access, permissions, licenses, team structures, and platform settings.
  • Configure Gong to support weekly forecast reviews, deal inspection, and manager coaching. Build and maintain views that help leaders spot deal risk, track forecast changes, and prepare for pipeline reviews.
  • Configure sales intelligence tools to support account research, prospecting, and contact enrichment. Set rules for which data flows into Salesforce and how to handle duplicates or conflicting values.
  • Monitor data flow between Gong, sales intelligence tools, and Salesforce. Investigate sync failures and data discrepancies. Partner with GTM Systems and vendors on integration changes and escalations.
  • Lead testing and rollout of new features. Document configurations, train users, and track adoption and license usage to inform renewal and expansion decisions.
  • Build agentic AI workflows that combine approved Gong and Salesforce data to flag deal risks and prepare forecast review briefs. Link findings to source records and route them to sales leaders for review.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 5–7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Finance, or related analytical roles, preferably within a SaaS or software environment.
  • Hands-on experience building, testing, deploying, and administering production commission plans in Spiff.
  • Experience owning full sales compensation cycles, including payout reconciliation, exception resolution, and approval workflows.
  • Experience producing Board or executive leadership reporting, including reconciling metrics across systems and writing concise variance commentary.
  • Demonstrated experience building AI agents and automated workflows using tools such as Claude or comparable platforms
  • Experience connecting agents to business systems, troubleshooting failures, and validating results.
  • Advanced Salesforce and Excel skills and experience building or maintaining reporting in Power BI or a comparable BI platform.

Asset Qualifications

  • Experience with commission tools (e.g., SPIFF or similar platforms).
  • Proficiency in SQL or other data querying languages.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV) and recurring revenue models.
  • Experience with territory planning, quota setting, and GTM strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and drive process improvements.

Note: Due to the nature of our work with public safety agencies, this position requires compliance with the FBI's Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Security Policy. Candidates must successfully pass a comprehensive, fingerprint-based background check. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on CJIS security requirements, please visit the FBI's CJIS Security Policy Resource Center.

Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

job.title: Engineering Manager – Backend, Data & AI
job.description:
At EX Squared LATAM, we are a digital transformation company focused on building innovative technology solutions that drive real business value. We partner with clients across global, regional, and local markets, creating a collaborative environment where curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning matter.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a multidisciplinary team of backend, data, and AI engineers for our client, a growing US-based B2B SaaS startup building an AI-powered CRM for investment professionals.

The primary focus of this position is people management, team performance, and reliable delivery. You will develop engineers, coordinate work across technical disciplines, establish clear expectations, and ensure the team meets deadlines while maintaining quality and sustainable workloads.

You should bring a strong technical background in backend software engineering, preferably with Python, and enough familiarity with data engineering and applied AI to guide a multidisciplinary team. You will participate in architecture discussions, challenge proposed solutions, assess technical trade-offs, and help engineers make sound decisions.

Location

Fully remote within LATAM, with full-time working hours aligned with US Eastern Time.

Contract Duration

Long-term, full-time independent contractor engagement, with monthly payments in USD through Deel.

Language Requirement

Advanced English, with the ability to lead technical discussions, performance conversations, and stakeholder communications entirely in English.

What you’ll do

Lead and develop people

  • Directly manage engineers across backend, data, and AI, establishing clear responsibilities, expectations, and goals.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide actionable feedback, lead performance reviews, and support individual development and career progression.
  • Address performance concerns promptly, agree on improvement plans, and follow through on results.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, and team development.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, open communication, and ownership.

Own team performance and delivery

  • Translate product and business priorities into realistic engineering plans, milestones, and delivery commitments.
  • Coordinate work across backend, data, and AI, managing dependencies and ensuring teams move toward shared objectives.
  • Monitor capacity and workloads, allocate responsibilities, and address blockers before they affect deadlines.
  • Track delivery progress, communicate risks early, and negotiate scope, sequencing, or timelines when priorities change.
  • Establish and use meaningful metrics to improve delivery predictability, quality, throughput, and team effectiveness.
  • Investigate recurring delays, defects, and QA bottlenecks, and lead improvements that address their underlying causes.

Provide technical direction

  • Participate in architecture and design discussions, helping the team evaluate scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and cost.
  • Question assumptions and proposed solutions constructively, ensuring technical decisions address the business problem.
  • Partner with technical leads and senior engineers to establish engineering standards and manage technical debt.
  • Maintain sufficient understanding of the platform to guide technical priorities, assess risks, and support escalation.
  • Help evaluate data and AI initiatives based on feasibility, dependencies, operational impact, and product value.

Partner with stakeholders

  • Work closely with Product, the VP of Engineering, the CTO, and other stakeholders to align priorities and expectations.
  • Communicate delivery status, team performance, incidents, and technical trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Introduce practical processes that support a growing startup without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with a substantial background in backend development and system design.
  • 3+ years of formal engineering people management, including direct reports, 1:1s, performance reviews, and coaching.
  • Proven ownership of engineering delivery, including planning, prioritization, capacity management, dependencies, and deadlines.
  • Experience using metrics to identify delivery or quality problems and drive measurable improvements.
  • Strong technical judgment, with the ability to review architecture, challenge implementation approaches, and guide experienced engineers.
  • Previous backend development experience, preferably with Python; familiarity with Django or Django REST Framework is valuable.
  • Familiarity with APIs, relational databases, integrations, and scalable cloud-based applications.
  • Working knowledge of data engineering concepts, including pipelines, transformations, data quality, and governance.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled products and the considerations involved in integrating AI capabilities into production systems.
  • Understanding of engineering practices such as code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and technical debt management.
  • Strong stakeholder management, clear communication, and the ability to make decisions under changing priorities.
  • Comfort working in a startup environment that requires autonomy, adaptability, and practical problem-solving.

What will make you stand out

  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams spanning backend, data engineering, and AI.
  • Experience in a growing B2B SaaS startup or product company.
  • Examples of improving delivery predictability, reducing defects, developing engineers, or resolving performance challenges.
  • Experience bringing separate engineering teams together and improving cross-team coordination.
  • Familiarity with Azure, Python-based backend ecosystems, and AI-powered product integrations.
  • Experience with CRM, investment technology, financial services, or other data-intensive products.
  • Practical experience introducing AI-assisted engineering workflows to improve team effectiveness.

Why EX Squared?

  • Collaborate with an international team on an evolving AI-powered product.
  • Shape engineering practices and support the growth of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Join a culture that values curiosity, ownership, learning, and collaboration.
